actions.name: Complete setup

actions.description: Verify required tools and project state without changing them.

actions.name: Repair environment
actions.description: Reapply required state and exact project pins without ordinary upgrades.

actions.name: Update environment
actions.description: Update compatible environment software without advancing project pins, update the checkout, then verify.

actions.name: Prepare repository
actions.description: Prepare the Git checkout and configure repository-local development state.

actions.name: Install project tools

actions.name: Prepare dependency cache
actions.description: Fetch or reuse the exact dependency sources required by the checkout.

actions.name: Configure MSYS2
actions.description: Install or repair declared UCRT64 and CLANG64 packages.

actions.name: Configure editors/IDEs
actions.description: Choose editors and install their GameWIP integrations.

actions.name: Build documentation
actions.description: Build and verify the generated manual.

actions.name: Install matching Tracy profiler tools
actions.description: Prepare or reuse the locked Tracy source, then build and install matching profiler tools.

actions.name: Install/repair Visual Studio
actions.description: Apply the repository Visual Studio configuration.

actions.name: Uninstall GameWIP-owned resources
actions.description: Inventory and remove only resources with sufficient GameWIP ownership evidence.
